no_api_findings.finding: The documented Rust standard library has no Matrix Market parser. std::fs::read and std::io::Read obtain local bytes but do not interpret the %%MatrixMarket banner, shape, or coordinate entries. No format-aware bundled API was available to run against the valid controls.

limit: This covers the documented Rust 1.99.1 standard library, not third-party crates or system numerical libraries.
